title: Law of Multiple Proportions — Verifying a Simple Whole-Number Ratio
notes: **Step 1 — divide by the smallest value:** take the calculated list of masses (or mass ratios), pick the smallest one, and divide every value in the list by it — this forces the smallest value to become exactly 1

**Step 2 — clear any remaining decimals:** if a result still ends in .5, .33/.66, or .25/.75, multiply every value in the list by a common factor to clear it — ×2 for .5, ×3 for .33/.66, ×4 for .25/.75 — until all values are whole numbers
**Alternative for already-whole numbers:** find the Highest Common Factor (HCF) of the numbers and divide each by it — e.g. 12:16 → HCF = 4 → 3:4
